summary.text: Logan Monson is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 69 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He works in healthcare administration and is a former mayor of Blanding.

paragraphs.text: Logan Monson was born in Provo, Utah, and earned a high school diploma from San Juan High School.
His career experience includes working in healthcare administration.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong resident of San Juan County, a husband, father, former mayor of Blanding and a healthcare professional.
Monson succeeded Phil Lyman in District 69 in 2025.
He defeated Daniel Gardner in the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, with 61.9 percent of the vote according to Ballotpedia, which noted that vote totals may change until results are certified.

In the Ballotpedia survey, Monson listed his policy interests as rural Utah and public lands, water and natural resources, healthcare and education, fiscal responsibility and limited government, public safety and strong families, and economic opportunity.
He wrote that he wants rural communities to have a strong voice in decisions made at the Capitol.
